hypothesis: The official pitcher pitch-mix counter and three cumulative group rates can reconstruct the coarse group of nearly every historical pitch. A selector trained on those dense labels should estimate the hidden current coarse group better than the prior TrackMan-only selector, and its group probabilities can legally constrain the sparse fine-pitch selector before control marginalization.

novelty_relative_to_prior_work.E22R_and_V5_pitchtype_MoE: trained the pitch selector only on rows matched to TrackMan
novelty_relative_to_prior_work.V5_fine_pitchtype_latent: predicted eight fine types directly from sparse TrackMan labels
novelty_relative_to_prior_work.this_experiment: derives dense coarse labels from official main-table pitchmix counter deltas, trains a dense coarse selector, and projects sparse fine probabilities onto its coarse marginals

data_contract.training_label_reconstruction: Next same-pitcher counter row only inside the supplied completed historical slice; boundary and inconsistent rows are dropped.
data_contract.validation_reconstructed_label_use: semantic and selector diagnostics only, never candidate construction

coarse_label_reconstruction.rule: Require next_n=current_n+1; rounded component deltas must be binary and sum to zero or one; residual increment is other.
coarse_label_reconstruction.on_fail: Close without target metrics or 2022+ labels.

selector.model: CatBoost MultiClass on the exact legal pre-pitch BASE_FEATURES
selector.training_rows: R rows from seasons strictly before validation with reconstructed coarse labels
selector.fine_selector: The existing tagged/auto eight-class CatBoost selector trained only on prior TrackMan rows
selector.hierarchical_projection: Within each learned fine-to-coarse mapping, preserve fine conditional ratios but replace/interpolate the coarse marginal with the dense coarse selector probability.

candidate_families.dense_coarse_control: Pitcher by reconstructed coarse-group centered control effects marginalized by dense selector probabilities versus the pitcher's completed-history repertoire.
candidate_families.hierarchical_fine_control: Pitcher by fine-type centered control effects marginalized by hierarchically projected fine probabilities versus the pitcher's fine repertoire.

selection_order: maximum minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
simpler dense_coarse before hierarchical_fine, larger shrinkage, smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze one family and all parameters before producing 2022 and 2023 predictions.
